mapper.update: create table if not exists hub_instance ( id bigint unsigned not null comment '主键', code varchar(64) not null comment '实例编码', display_name varchar(128) not null comment '实例名称', opencli_profile varchar(128) not null comment 'OpenCLI profile', context_id varchar(128) null comment 'Browser Bridge contextId', vnc_endpoint varchar(512) null comment 'VNC访问地址', state varchar(32) not null comment '实例状态', max_pending int not null comment '最大排队数', supported_commands_json longtext not null comment '支持的命令列表', gmt_create datetime(3) not null default current_timestamp(3) comment '创建时间', gmt_modified datetime(3) not null default current_timestamp(3) on update current_timestamp(3) comment '更新时间', version bigint not null default '0' comment '数据版本号', primary key (id), unique key uk_hub_instance_code (code) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='OpenCLI浏览器实例表';
mapper.insert: insert into hub_instance ( id, code, display_name, opencli_profile, context_id, vnc_endpoint, state, max_pending, supported_commands_json, gmt_create, gmt_modified, version ) values ( #{id}, #{code}, #{displayName}, #{opencliProfile}, #{contextId}, #{vncEndpoint}, #{state}, #{maxPending}, #{supportedCommandsJson}, #{createTime}, #{modifiedTime}, 0 )
mapper.update: update hub_instance set code = #{code}, display_name = #{displayName}, opencli_profile = #{opencliProfile}, context_id = #{contextId}, vnc_endpoint = #{vncEndpoint}, state = #{state}, max_pending = #{maxPending}, supported_commands_json = #{supportedCommandsJson}, gmt_modified = #{modifiedTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from hub_instance order by id asc
